claim: Proving that a recorded pathname still exists proves the record at that path is intact.

environment.what: append-only receipt stores kept in git

witness.expect: 'a committed receipt rewritten under the same name' is rejected
witness.negative_control: the committed receipts themselves validate, so the rule does not reject all content

applies_until: Content is compared against the bytes first committed at that path, or an external anchor holds the digest.
